# Supported mechanics

Rules version: Comprehensive Rules effective 2026-09-25.

## Card types

| Name | Rules | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`artifact`](docs/reference/types.md#artifact) | 301.1 | A permanent cast at sorcery speed. |
| [`creature`](docs/reference/types.md#creature) | 302.1, 302.4, 302.6, 307.1 | A permanent with power and toughness that can attack and block. Cast at sorcery speed. It can't attack or use {T} abilities unless controlled continuously since its controller's most recent turn began (summoning sickness). |
| [`enchantment`](docs/reference/types.md#enchantment) | 303.1 | A permanent cast at sorcery speed. |
| [`instant`](docs/reference/types.md#instant) | 304.1, 304.2, 608.2n | A spell cast any time its controller has priority. Its spell ability resolves, then it goes to the graveyard. |
| [`land`](docs/reference/types.md#land) | 305.1, 305.2, 305.3, 202.1a | A permanent played with the special action "play a land" (one per turn, main phase, empty stack). It has no mana cost. |
| [`planeswalker`](docs/reference/types.md#planeswalker) | 306.5b, 306.8, 120.3c, 606.3, 704.5i | A permanent that enters with loyalty counters equal to its printed loyalty. Its loyalty abilities can be activated at sorcery speed, one per turn. Damage dealt to it removes loyalty counters; at 0 loyalty it is put into its owner's graveyard. |
| [`sorcery`](docs/reference/types.md#sorcery) | 307.1, 307.2, 608.2n | A spell cast only in its controller's main phase while the stack is empty. |

## Keyword abilities

| Name | Rules | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`deathtouch`](docs/reference/keywords.md#deathtouch) | 702.2b, 702.2c, 704.5h | Any damage it deals to a creature is enough to destroy it; 1 damage counts as lethal when assigning combat damage. |
| [`defender`](docs/reference/keywords.md#defender) | 702.3b | Can't attack. |
| [`double_strike`](docs/reference/keywords.md#double_strike) | 702.4b, 510.4 | Deals combat damage in both the first-strike and the regular combat damage step. |
| [`first_strike`](docs/reference/keywords.md#first_strike) | 702.7b, 510.4 | Deals combat damage in a first combat damage step, before creatures without first strike. |
| [`flash`](docs/reference/keywords.md#flash) | 702.8a | You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant. |
| [`flying`](docs/reference/keywords.md#flying) | 702.9b | Can't be blocked except by creatures with flying or reach. |
| [`haste`](docs/reference/keywords.md#haste) | 702.10a, 302.6 | This creature can attack and use {T} abilities even if it hasn't been under your control continuously since your most recent turn began. |
| [`hexproof`](docs/reference/keywords.md#hexproof) | 702.11b | Can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control. |
| [`indestructible`](docs/reference/keywords.md#indestructible) | 702.12b | Can't be destroyed: lethal damage, deathtouch and "destroy" effects don't put it into the graveyard. |
| [`lifelink`](docs/reference/keywords.md#lifelink) | 702.15b | Damage dealt by this source also causes its controller to gain that much life. |
| [`menace`](docs/reference/keywords.md#menace) | 702.111b | Can't be blocked except by two or more creatures. |
| [`reach`](docs/reference/keywords.md#reach) | 702.17b | Can block creatures with flying. |
| [`trample`](docs/reference/keywords.md#trample) | 702.19b, 702.19e | Excess combat damage beyond lethal damage to its blockers can be assigned to the player or planeswalker it's attacking. |
| [`vigilance`](docs/reference/keywords.md#vigilance) | 702.20b | Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap. |

## Abilities

| Name | Rules | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`activated`](docs/reference/abilities.md#activated) | 602.1, 602.2, 602.5d | An activated ability: announce it, choose targets, pay its costs, then it goes on the stack. `timing: "sorcery"` restricts it to sorcery speed. |
| [`double_counters`](docs/reference/abilities.md#double_counters) | 614.1a, 122.6, 122.6a, 616.1 | While this permanent is on the battlefield, if its controller would put one or more counters (only `counter`, if given) on a permanent matching `affects` ({"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any}, relative to this permanent's controller), the number put is doubled. This includes counters a permanent enters with. |
| [`enters_tapped`](docs/reference/abilities.md#enters_tapped) | 614.1c, 614.12 | This permanent enters the battlefield tapped (a self-replacement effect). |
| [`enters_tapped_unless_pay_life`](docs/reference/abilities.md#enters_tapped_unless_pay_life) | 614.12, 119.4 | As this permanent enters, its controller may pay `life` life; if they don't, it enters tapped. You can't pay more life than you have. |
| [`enters_with_counters`](docs/reference/abilities.md#enters_with_counters) | 614.1c, 614.12, 122.6, 122.6a | Without `affects`: this permanent enters with the `counters` on it. With `affects` ({"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any, "other": true}, relative to this permanent's controller): while this permanent is on the battlefield, each matching permanent enters with the `counters` in addition to any others. |
| [`loyalty`](docs/reference/abilities.md#loyalty) | 606.3, 606.4, 606.5, 602.2b | A loyalty ability. Its cost adds (positive) or removes (negative) loyalty counters and is paid on activation. Sorcery speed, and only one loyalty ability per planeswalker per turn. |
| [`mana`](docs/reference/abilities.md#mana) | 605.1a, 605.3a, 605.3b, 106.4 | An activated mana ability: pay the cost, add the mana to your mana pool immediately. It does not use the stack and can be activated whenever you have priority. |
| [`spell`](docs/reference/abilities.md#spell) | 113.3a, 601.2c, 608.2b, 608.2c | The spell ability of an instant or sorcery: its targets are chosen while casting and its effects happen in order when it resolves. If every target is illegal on resolution, it doesn't resolve. |
| [`static`](docs/reference/abilities.md#static) | 604.1, 611.3a, 613.1f, 613.4c | While its source is on the battlefield, every matching permanent gets `pump` and/or the `keywords`. `affects` is {"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any, "other": true} (relative to the source's controller). |
| [`triggered`](docs/reference/abilities.md#triggered) | 603.2, 603.3, 603.3b, 603.3d | A triggered ability: when its trigger condition happens, it is put on the stack the next time a player would receive priority (in APNAP order), with targets chosen then. |

## Trigger conditions

| Name | Rules | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`attacks`](docs/reference/triggers.md#attacks) | 508.3a | The subject is declared as an attacker. |
| [`cast`](docs/reference/triggers.md#cast) | 603.2, 601.2i | A player casts a spell. `controller`: you (default) | opponent | any; `spell`: optional filter on the spell's card types (e.g. "creature", "noncreature"). |
| [`dies`](docs/reference/triggers.md#dies) | 603.6c, 603.10a, 700.4 | The subject is put into a graveyard from the battlefield. Looks back in time (CR 603.10a). |
| [`enters`](docs/reference/triggers.md#enters) | 603.6a, 603.2 | The subject enters the battlefield. |
| [`step_begins`](docs/reference/triggers.md#step_begins) | 603.6b, 503.1a, 513.1a | A step begins. `whose`: "your" (default), "each" or "opponent". |

## Effects

| Name | Rules | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`add_counters`](docs/reference/effects.md#add_counters) | 122.1, 122.6, 613.4c | Put `amount` counters named `counter` on each referenced permanent. Any counter name works (+1/+1, -1/-1, loyalty, stun, shield, oil, a keyword, ...); see docs/reference/counters.md for the ones with rules. |
| [`counter`](docs/reference/effects.md#counter) | 701.6a | Counter each referenced spell: it leaves the stack for its owner's graveyard without resolving. |
| [`create_token`](docs/reference/effects.md#create_token) | 111.1, 111.10, 701.7a, 704.5d | Create `amount` tokens under the referenced player's control (default: you). `token` is a predefined token name (Treasure, Clue, Food) or an inline card definition. `tapped: true` creates them tapped. |
| [`deal_damage`](docs/reference/effects.md#deal_damage) | 120.3a, 120.3c, 120.3e, 120.6 | Deal `amount` damage to each referenced creature, planeswalker or player. Damage to a player causes life loss; to a planeswalker removes loyalty counters; to a creature is marked until cleanup. |
| [`destroy`](docs/reference/effects.md#destroy) | 701.8a | Destroy each referenced permanent (it goes to its owner's graveyard). |
| [`discard`](docs/reference/effects.md#discard) | 701.9a, 701.9b | Each referenced player discards `amount` cards of their choice (default: you). |
| [`draw`](docs/reference/effects.md#draw) | 121.1, 121.2 | Each referenced player draws `amount` cards (default: you). |
| [`exile`](docs/reference/effects.md#exile) | 406.1, 701.13a | Exile each referenced permanent. |
| [`gain_life`](docs/reference/effects.md#gain_life) | 119.3 | Each referenced player gains `amount` life (default: you). |
| [`grant`](docs/reference/effects.md#grant) | 611.2a, 611.2c, 613.1f, 514.2 | Each referenced permanent gains the `keywords` until end of turn. |
| [`lose_life`](docs/reference/effects.md#lose_life) | 119.3 | Each referenced player loses `amount` life. |
| [`mill`](docs/reference/effects.md#mill) | 701.17a | Each referenced player puts the top `amount` cards of their library into their graveyard (default: you). |
| [`pump`](docs/reference/effects.md#pump) | 611.2a, 611.2c, 613.4c, 514.2 | Each referenced creature gets +power/+toughness until end of turn. The set of affected creatures is locked in when the effect starts. |
| [`return_to_hand`](docs/reference/effects.md#return_to_hand) | 400.6 | Return each referenced permanent to its owner's hand. |
| [`scry`](docs/reference/effects.md#scry) | 701.22a | Look at the top `amount` cards of your library; put any number on the bottom and the rest on top in any order. |
| [`surveil`](docs/reference/effects.md#surveil) | 701.25a | Look at the top `amount` cards of your library; put any number into your graveyard and the rest on top in any order. |
| [`tap`](docs/reference/effects.md#tap) | 701.26a | Tap each referenced permanent. |
| [`untap`](docs/reference/effects.md#untap) | 701.26b | Untap each referenced permanent. |

## Counters with rules

| Name | Rules | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`+1/+1`](docs/reference/counters.md#+1/+1) | 122.1a, 122.3, 613.4c, 704.5q | Adds 1 to power and toughness (layer 7c). Any +X/+Y or -X/-Y counter works the same way. If a permanent has both +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters, N of each are removed as a state-based action (N = the smaller count). |
| [`-1/-1`](docs/reference/counters.md#-1/-1) | 122.1a, 122.3, 613.4c, 704.5q | Subtracts 1 from power and toughness (layer 7c). |
| [`finality`](docs/reference/counters.md#finality) | 122.1h, 614.1a | If the permanent would be put into a graveyard from the battlefield, it is exiled instead. |
| [`keyword`](docs/reference/counters.md#keyword) | 122.1b, 613.1f | A counter named after a keyword (flying, first_strike, double_strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, vigilance) gives the permanent that keyword (layer 6). Write the keyword itself as the counter name. |
| [`loyalty`](docs/reference/counters.md#loyalty) | 122.1e, 306.5b, 704.5i | A planeswalker's loyalty; at 0 it is put into its owner's graveyard. |
| [`shield`](docs/reference/counters.md#shield) | 122.1c, 614.1a, 615.1a, 701.8b | If the permanent would be destroyed by an effect, instead remove a shield counter. If damage would be dealt to it, prevent it and remove a shield counter (simultaneous damage, such as combat damage, removes only one). |
| [`stun`](docs/reference/counters.md#stun) | 122.1d, 502.3, 701.26b | If the permanent would become untapped (untap step or an effect), instead one stun counter is removed from it. |
